## Question

How should an analysis identify the version of history it used?

## Method

Keep the effective date of each observation separate from the extraction timestamp of its source. If a source supplies release identifiers or revision dates, retain those too.

## Illustrative example

A June employment record retrieved in July can differ from the same June record retrieved in August after a correction. The effective period is unchanged; the available information has changed.

## Reporting convention

Publish the observation period, source release, extraction timestamp, transformation steps, and treatment of revisions alongside each output. Preserve permitted source snapshots or a durable retrieval recipe.

## Limitations and sources

This note proposes a documentation convention. It does not report empirical results. Source-specific revision policies must be documented in each future analysis.
